title: Boise branch expansion business case
prompt:
Evaluate the proposed Boise service branch on a standalone after-tax basis.

Begin with the July capital-committee and long-range-plan thread in `Requests/`, including the post-committee clarification. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Build a six-year model with ramped technician count, jobs per technician, price, variable labor/material cost, local fixed cost, opening capex, working capital, tax, maintenance capex, and terminal recovery. Calculate NPV at the approved hurdle, IRR, discounted payback, year-three EBITDA margin, and the break-even jobs-per-technician level. Return `discounted_payback_years` as null if cumulative discounted cash flow never recovers the opening investment within the six-year forecast. Do not include corporate allocations that are not incremental.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `npv`, `irr`, `discounted_payback_years`, `year_three_ebitda_margin`, `break_even_jobs_per_technician`, `recommendation`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
